title: Double-reward prevention

qualification.milestone: third CMP-5 integration milestone — shared one-time external reward-consumption authority

exit_criteria: one canonical external work commitment maps to one chain-scoped claim key independent of proof credit reward reference evidence or source wrapper
a canonical work claim can be consumed only once
alternate proof credit evidence and alternate reward references cannot create a second claim for the same canonical work
alternate external source wrappers cannot create a second claim for the same canonical work
unauthorized callers cannot front-run or burn claims
only governance may authorize or revoke consumers and authorized consumers must be deployed code with pinned runtime code hash
zero canonical work reward reference evidence and invalid external-source bindings fail closed
the guard records exact source binding consumer reward reference evidence and consumption time for auditability
the guard creates no external-truth reward-amount reward-eligibility settlement stake slash proof-verification or credit-issuance authority and CMP-5.7 remains the truth owner
dedicated adversarial tests mechanical verifier retained Compute regressions and exact-head Compute Market qualification pass
intentionally_deferred: CMP-5.7 External-result attestation and authoritative canonical-work mapping
CMP-6 useful-computation reward economics and payout integration
live reward consumer deployment and ProtocolRegistry publication
